rows.meaning: Unique among pages; equals the file name meta/pages/<id>.json
Heading of the page and its label in the navigation. The URL is derived from it: "New employee" opens at /new-employee
Optional: the layout (frame) the page is shown in, by id from meta/layouts
Optional: a group name for navigation; a nav field can show one section, or one link per section
Optional: position in navigation and in previous/next, lowest first
Every field of the page once, keyed by its id
Where the fields go, per screen size: desktop (required), tablet and mobile (optional)
